name: Fallback research (Claygent)
agentName: Eightfold | Fallback research for missing talent and HCM fields
agentPrompt:
Organization: {{account_name}} ({{account_domain}}), country {{country}}.
Missing fields: {{missing_fields}}.

Research ONLY the missing fields listed above, using official company pages, the company careers site, press releases and other authoritative public sources.

- talent_leader: the current CHRO, Chief People Officer, Head of Talent Acquisition or Head of Talent Intelligence at this organization (not a subsidiary unless the subsidiary is the named organization). Return the person's name, exact title, the month they started the role (YYYY-MM) and the source URL.
- talent_leader_start_date: the month the existing leader ({{talent_leader_name}}) started the current role.
- hcm: the HCM / HRIS and applicant tracking systems the organization runs (for example Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM, UKG, iCIMS, Greenhouse). Return the systems and a source URL.

Rules:
- Do not infer an HCM from a careers-page vendor alone; a careers site hosted by an ATS is evidence of the ATS only.
- Do not infer parent ownership from a similar name.
- Do not infer a leadership change from a press mention without a date.
- Leave a field empty when the evidence does not establish it. Never guess.
- Never contradict a verified structured result; you are filling gaps only.

leader_name.description: Talent leader full name, empty if not established

leader_title.description: Exact current title, empty if not established

leader_start_date.description: Role start month YYYY-MM, empty if not established

leader_source_url.description: Source URL for the leader finding, empty if none

hcm_systems.description: HCM/HRIS/ATS systems found, comma separated, empty if not established

hcm_source_url.description: Source URL for the HCM finding, empty if none

evidence.description: One or two sentences quoting or summarizing the supporting evidence

uncertainty.description: How well the evidence supports the findings
